title: Pin Your Important Notices
message:
• **Slide Right to Pin**: Slide any notice to the right to pin it to the top!
• **Slide Left to Delete**: Slide left to remove notices you don't need.
• Pinned notices always stay pinned even when you change languages.

title: 2.7.5 Updates
message:
• Now, you can receive in-app updates! Like this.
• Added **Send Feedback** button in Settings.
• Join our [Reddit community](https://www.reddit.com/r/DigitalStickyNotesApp/)!
• Now your deleted notes are safe for some time in the Recycle Bin.
